in_sanskrit.name: किषणसिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Kishansinh' is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Kishan' and 'Singh'. 'Kishan' is a name of the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as the god of abundance, prosperity, and protector of the earth. 'Singh', on the other hand, is a Sanskrit word for 'lion', which is a symbol of courage, strength, and royalty in Hinduism. Together, 'Kishansinh' can be interpreted as 'The Lion of God of Abundance' or 'The Protector of Prosperity'.

in_hindi.name: Kishansinh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fortune
in_hindi.long_meaning: Kishansinh एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kishansinh is a compound name, consisting of 'Kishan' and 'Sinh'. 'Kishan' means 'God of Fortune' and 'Sinh' means 'Lion'. Therefore, Kishansinh can be interpreted as 'God of Fortune, who is as powerful as a lion'.
